items.title: 2.3 Electronic configuration ke experimental saboot (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.3, printed page 25.

blocks.text: Atom ke electrons ki tarteeb (electronic structure) ka aaj ka nazariya (theory) Bohr Model se shuru hua. Is model aur baad ke models ke saboot (evidence) zyada tar do cheezon se aate hain: atomic spectra aur ionization energies. Agle do topics in dono ko bari bari dekhte hain.

blocks.prompt: Electrons ki tarteeb ke model ke liye do alag qism ke tajurbe (experiments) kyun faidemand hain?
blocks.explanation: Atomic spectra dikhate hain ke electrons fixed energy levels mein rehte hain, kyun ke sirf kuch khaas wavelengths nikalti ya jazb (absorb) hoti hain. Ionization energies naapti hain ke har electron kitni mazbooti se pakra hua hai, aur yun shells nazar aate hain. Dono ek doosre ki tasdeeq (confirm) karte hain.

items: Electronic structure ka nazariya Bohr model se shuru hota hai; saboot atomic spectra aur ionization energies se aata hai.
